He was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three. David set him over his guard.

translations.web: Of the three, he was more honorable than the two, and was made their captain; however he wasn’t included in the three.
translations.bsb: He was doubly honored above the Three, and he became their commander, even though he was not included among the Three.
translations.kjv: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the first three.
translations.asv: Of the three, he was more honorable than the two, and was made their captain: howbeit he attained not to the first three.
